title: Standard opens form a basis on Proj
statement: Let $S$ be a graded commutative ring [def-pc-proj] and let $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. The standard opens $D_+(f)$ for positive-degree homogeneous $f$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero] form a basis for the topology of $X$; each $D_+(f)$ is affine.

source.place: Algebra Lemma 00JP (algebra-lemma-topology-proj), part (5): the D_+(f) form a basis; Constructions Lemma 01MB (constructions-lemma-proj-scheme): the D_+(f) are affine

proof.text: The standard opens form a basis of the topology by [lem-weil-pbc-proj-standard-open-inclusion], clause (0), which states this for every positive-degree homogeneous element of the nonnegatively graded ring S.

source.place: Constructions Section 01M3 and Lemma 01M4 (label lemma-standard-open), clause (0); Algebra Lemma 00JP (label lemma-topology-proj), part (5)

proof.text: For each positive-degree homogeneous f, the standard open D_+(f) is affine because [def-nagata-affine-proj] identifies it with Spec(S_(f),0) via Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec.

source.place: Constructions Lemma 01MB (label lemma-proj-scheme), the affine identification D_+(f) = Spec(S_(f))

proof_origin.place: Constructions Section 01M3, Lemmas 01M4 and 01MB; Algebra Lemma 00JP
